title: calibration_evaluation_v1
description: Per-head LOOCV residual evaluation sidecar emitted alongside the calibration_head_v1.json trained-head sidecar. Records p50/p90/p99 residuals + bootstrap p90 standard error + per-fold absolute residuals for each of the three calibrators (Isotonic + Platt + Beta), the uncalibrated-baseline residual table for the same cells, the chosen head + the simplicity_one_se_rule rationale, the target_arch (sm_86_only for this loop's active scope), the comparison_contract.toml sha256 pin, and the source commit at evaluation time. A downstream comparison_runner reads chosen_head + loocv_table[chosen_head].p90 to decide whether to fire the calibration_loocv_p90_residual_exceeded typed reason against the DEC-T5 threshold of 0.30.

chosen_head.description: Calibrator class name chosen by selection_rule. MUST be a key in loocv_table.

selection_rule.description: Per DEC-T9 the selection rule is pinned to simplicity_one_se_rule. Pick the simplest head (Platt < Isotonic < Beta) whose LOOCV p90 residual is within 1 * loocv_p90_se_best of the best p90 across all three heads.

loocv_table.description: Per-head LOOCV residual block keyed by the calibrator class name. All three heads MUST be present even if one was not chosen; the evaluation gates need to compare across heads.

uncalibrated_baseline_table.description: Baseline residuals |predicted - label| (no calibration head applied) for every training cell. Lets the reviewer judge whether calibration delivers any improvement over the raw predictor.

target_arch.description: This loop's active scope pins the fit to sm_86 only. A follow-up cross-arch loop will emit a separate evaluation sidecar with target_arch covering sm_86 + sm_120.

comparison_contract_sha256.description: SHA-256 of workloads/simbench_bw/comparison_contract.toml at fitting time. A drifted contract changes the meaning of admitted labels and invalidates the fit.

source_commit.description: Full 40-hex SHA of HEAD at fitting time.

training_cells.description: Identities of the cells used to compute the LOOCV table. Must match the calibration_head_v1.json sidecar's training_cells list.

rationale.description: Selection-rule rationale block. The simplicity_one_se_rule picks the simplest head whose p90 is within `se_threshold` (= 1.0 * loocv_p90_se of the best head) of `best_p90`. chosen_head_p90_distance_from_best = chosen_head_p90 - best_p90 (non-negative).

se_p90.description: Bootstrap standard error of the p90 estimate over the LOOCV fold-residual list. 1000 resamples with replacement.

per_fold_residuals.description: Per-LOOCV-fold absolute residuals: for each held-out cell i, fit on the remaining n-1 cells, compute |calibrator.transform(predicted_i) - label_i|.
